item.title: AST Blog: February Tornado Statistics in Arkansas
item.description: February isn’t technically tornado season in Arkansas, but neither is it excluded. There’s always a possibility of thunderstorms causing tornadoes even in the middle of winter, and in February, an average of two tornadoes take place. It may be quiet, but not silent, as there have been some quiet tornadoes hitting parts of the state since February 1950, including central Arkansas.
